Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Asheboro for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, at least 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (the Mayor's Tree Lighting) through December 11 (Christmas on Sunset), with the Asheboro Christmas Parade already listed and a live nativity, carriage rides and Santa on Sunset Avenue. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Asheboro

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Asheboro
  • Free events, including Christmas on Sunset
  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mrs. Claus at Christmas on Sunset (December 11)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Mayor's Tree Lighting and the Christmas Parade (live cards), Christmas on Sunset (December 11)
  • Season: November 28 to December 11

Planning a bigger day out? Asheboro families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Greensboro, which covers the Greensboro Science Center and the Triad's biggest holiday shows.
